verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas explicitly documents a scriptable Editor API module (api.playcanvas.com/editor) built 'for developers looking to... create custom editing tools, or integrate external data and systems into the PlayCanvas Editor environment,' plus an official MCP server for AI-driven automation of live Editor sessions, and community-built sync tools for local file mapping — together showing programmatic extension of the editor itself. Missing for 10: concrete example plugins/marketplace or hands-on demonstration of a third-party editor tool built with this API, and no independent review confirming ease of use for this specific API (only general dev-experience complaints exist).
